description: Phase 8: Presenter Remote - Extend the web server with /remote endpoint for phone/tablet browser control. PIN security, multi-remote WebSocket sync, slide navigation, go live/black/logo, service order navigation.
steps: Add PresenterSettings fields: RemoteEnabled (bool), RemotePin (string, 4-digit default '1234'), RemoteAllowSlideAdvance (bool, true), RemoteAllowItemNavigation (bool, true), RemoteAllowDisplayControl (bool, true).

Extend StageDisplayServer with /remote endpoint that serves a mobile-optimized HTML/CSS/JS control page. The page shows: current slide text, next slide preview, transport buttons (Prev Slide, Next Slide, Prev Item, Next Item), display buttons (Go Live, Black, Logo), service order list with tap-to-navigate.
Add /remote/auth POST endpoint: accepts JSON {pin: '1234'}, returns a session token (JWT or simple random token) stored in localStorage. All WebSocket connections from /remote require valid token.

Create WebSocket endpoint /ws/remote that: authenticates via token query param, receives commands (nextSlide, prevSlide, nextItem, prevItem, goLive, goBlack, showLogo, goToItem:N, goToSlide:N), sends state updates to all connected remotes (current slide, item, live/black state).

Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/RemoteCommandHandler.cs that processes incoming WebSocket commands and calls the appropriate PresenterEngine methods. Validates permissions against RemoteAllow* settings.

The remote HTML page must: (a) prompt for PIN on first visit, (b) store token in localStorage, (c) show real-time slide content updates, (d) have large touch-friendly buttons, (e) work in both portrait and landscape, (f) show a 'connected' indicator and disconnect warning.
Add /remote/status GET endpoint that returns JSON with connected remote count and their names.
Write unit tests for RemoteCommandHandler (command parsing, permission checks).
acceptance_criteria: GET /remote serves mobile-optimized HTML control page
Commands (nextSlide, prevSlide, goLive, etc.) execute on PresenterEngine
Multiple remotes sync in real-time via WebSocket broadcast
findings: All 188 tests pass (39 new RemoteCommandHandler tests). Build succeeds with 0 errors. ServiceOrderManager requires a path argument - tests use /tmp/test-service-orders as a dummy path with CreateNew/AddItem for in-memory setup. PresenterEngine.cs was linked into the test project alongside RemoteCommandHandler.cs since both are in net8.0-windows Presenter project.
